definition.description: Encodes text to Base64 or decodes Base64 to text. Select the operation mode and provide the input string.
definition.iconSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M4 7V4H20V7M10 4V20M14 4V20M4 20H20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="12" y="14" text-anchor="middle" font-size="6" font-weight="bold" fill="currentColor">64</text></svg>

inputFields.helpText: Select 'encode' to convert text to Base64, or 'decode' to convert Base64 back to text.

inputFields.placeholderText: Text to encode or Base64 to decode
inputFields.helpText: For encode mode: provide plain text. For decode mode: provide a valid Base64 string.

outputParameters.description: The encoded Base64 string or decoded text
The operation that was performed (encode or decode)
Length of the input string in characters
Length of the result string in characters
True if an error occurred during the operation
Error details if the operation failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when the encode/decode operation succeeded
Triggered when the operation fails (e.g., invalid Base64 input)
